questions.question_text: Provincial Alcohol RegulationsWhat is the legal drinking age in most Canadian provinces, such as Ontario and British Columbia?

options.text: 18 years old
19 years old
21 years old
16 years oldCorrect Answer: b) 19 years old

questions.question_text: Cannabis LawsWhere can you legally purchase cannabis for recreational use in Canada?

options.text: From any private individual
From government-authorized retailers or licensed online sources
From any convenience store
From friends at a discounted rateCorrect Answer: b) From government-authorized retailers or licensed online sources

questions.question_text: Consent Laws and Campus Safety PoliciesWhat is a key principle of consent under Canadian law?

options.text: Consent is assumed unless someone says “no”
Consent must be clear, voluntary, and ongoing
Consent is only required for physical contact
Consent cannot be withdrawn once givenCorrect Answer: b) Consent must be clear, voluntary, and ongoing

questions.question_text: Tenant Rights and Housing Legal ProtectionsWhat is a legal right for renters under most provincial landlord-tenant laws in Canada?

options.text: Landlords can enter your rental unit anytime without notice
Landlords must provide 24-hour notice before entering, except in emergencies
Landlords can evict you without any notice
Landlords can increase rent without any limits or noticeCorrect Answer: b) Landlords must provide 24-hour notice before entering, except in emergencies

questions.question_text: Consumer Rights and Financial Legal ProtectionsWhat should you do if you purchase a defective product in Canada, such as a malfunctioning laptop?

options.text: Accept the loss since it’s your responsibility
Return it to the store for a repair or refund if within a reasonable time, with a receipt
Ignore the issue and buy a new one
Complain on social media without contacting the sellerCorrect Answer: b) Return it to the store for a repair or refund if within a reasonable time, with a receipt
